redirect_rules.description: Proposed exact legacy public root redirect
redirect_rules.expression: (http.host eq "seller.letbuyy.com") and http.request.uri.path eq "/" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"}

redirect_rules.description: Proposed exact legacy public root redirect
redirect_rules.expression: (http.host in {"developer.letbuyy.com" "developers.letbuyy.com"}) and http.request.uri.path eq "/" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"}

unmatched_path_guard.expression: (http.host in {"seller.letbuyy.com" "developer.letbuyy.com" "developers.letbuyy.com"}) and not (http.request.uri.path eq "/" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"})
